page.overview:
Who is Arnold?

Arnold is an employee at the Grocery Store who works alongside the Grocery Clerk. When the Grocery Clerk tells Selma Bouvier he is not allowed to date customers, his co-worker tries to correct him, but the Clerk shushes him so he can keep his excuse not to date Selma.
